spec_match.rationale: Grounds the demo in the WebIDL contract the feature rides on: unknown enum values throw TypeError while unknown dictionary keys are ignored, both demonstrated with real calls, plus the readback probe the HTML spec's getContextAttributes makes possible.

interactive.rationale: Three run buttons execute the wrong existence probe, the ignored-key vs throwing-enum pair, and the correct try/catch+readback probe across five enum values including the separate rec2100-linear.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises the two wrong ways that look right and the honest one, which is exactly the page's three probes.

edge_cases.rationale: This page IS the edge-case angle: the counterexample text adapts to whether the current browser proves the trap ('THIS browser is the counterexample'), the typo-key line shows silent default fallback, and rec2100-linear is separated as its own experimental feature.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5122501071994880, WebIDL enum semantics, and the rec2100-linear chromestatus entry.

conformance.rationale: The suite's unknown-enum-value-throws assertion (kind: throws) pins this page's central contract and passes on Chromium 141; the round-trip assertions pin the correct-probe rows. Verified executing on /conformance/.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable here): autorun DOM shows the existence probe returning true while the readback returns false — the counterexample branch — plus 'unknown ENUM VALUE: threw TypeError' and the five-row probe table; screenshots at both classes read; zero page console errors over CDP.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts trap-enum-throws on the contract (failing the assert if a browser ever accepts an unknown value), plus trap-exists-probe-ran and trap-correct-probe-ran with result payloads.

design_system.rationale: wrong/right badges use accent-rose/accent-emerald with ivory text (AA for the bold small-caps size), all other chrome from styles.css variables, buttons set background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: Buttons carry descriptive visible labels, outputs are aria-live, code samples are tabbable pre blocks, the results table has caption and scoped headers, and badges are text (wrong/right), not colour alone.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-measured no horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3; code blocks scroll internally; both class screenshots read.

guidanceConsulted.query: communicating pass fail state not by color alone
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Never rely on colour alone to convey status; pair with text.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts are literal words (wrong/right, true/false, throws) with colour as reinforcement; outputs are aria-live so probe results are announced.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give preformatted code its own horizontal scroll rather than letting it stretch the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All .snippet pre blocks use overflow-x:auto; CDP confirmed the page itself never overflows at 360px.

summary: The edge/failure/migration angle: demonstrates why existence checks and ignored-member assumptions mis-detect enum extensions, and ships the correct try/catch+readback probe, run live against five values. On Chromium 141 the page itself is the counterexample (property exists, values rejected). Verified at both device classes with clean console.
